upgrades.name: Speedboost
upgrades.tooltip: Enables a speedboost ability for harvesters.

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: Pulls gems towards the homebase. Closer gems gets pulled faster.

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer: Magnitude
upgrades.tooltip: The strength of the homebase's magnet effect on nearby gems.

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer: Falloff
upgrades.tooltip: Falloff strength.

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer: Max Distance
upgrades.tooltip: Maximum pull distance

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer: Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Cooldown.

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer: Duration
upgrades.tooltip: Duration.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer: Harvesters
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer ability also effects harvesters.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer ability also effects drones.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer: Beacons
upgrades.tooltip: Creates beacons around the homebase which also pulls gems in.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer: Beacon Collection
upgrades.tooltip: Allows beacons to also collect the gems it pulls in.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: Enables the chain magnetizer ability for the homebase.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer: Aftershock
upgrades.tooltip: For each chain there is a chance for a secondary chain to spawn.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer: Aftershock Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Increase chance to trigger a secondary chain.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer: Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of the Chain Magnetizer cooldown.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer: Number of chains
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of chains.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer: Harvesters
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each harvester.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each drone.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer Harvesters: Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of chains for harvester.

upgrades.name: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys temporary drones to collect gems.

upgrades.name: Drones: Reduce Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce cooldown of Drones ability.

upgrades.name: Increase Drone Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the number of drones.

upgrades.name: Increase Drone Time to Live
upgrades.tooltip: Increase time to live for drones.

upgrades.name: Drone Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the speed of drones.

upgrades.name: Harvester Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys a drone from harvester for each X units moved (when drones ability is active)

upgrades.name: Harvester Drones: Travel Distance
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce distance harvesters have to travel before spawning a new drone.

upgrades.name: Drone Recharge
upgrades.tooltip: Increase time to live for drones when collecting gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner
upgrades.tooltip: Spawns gems in a circle around the home base.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Numer of Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of gems spawned.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the cooldown of the Gem Spawner ability.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Number of Rings
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of rings spawned. Each subsequent ring will spawn 50% number of gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Ring Reduction
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce reduction percentage for eqch subsequent ring.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Harvesters
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each harvester with 30% number of gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each drone with 10% number of gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Quality Upgrade
upgrades.tooltip: Allows the chance for higher quality gems to spawn.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Quality Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Increase chance to spawn higher quality gems.
